Name: Muse - Leah dialogue expansion
Author: glacierpinecone
Description:
[b][size=4]Preface[/size][/b]:  My English is not good, so the dialogues in this module are all written in Chinese and then machine-translated into English. Please forgive any errors. If you want to translate them into more idiomatic English or other languages, I would be very grateful.

这是一个属于莉亚的对话扩展模组，不仅在原版对话的基础上[size=4][b]重写[/b][/size]了她的日常、婚后及节日对话，更在此基础上，[size=4][b]新增了230+全新对话[/b][/size]。使她成为了一位更浪漫的、对于周遭世界有更细腻感受的艺术家。 
另外，由于原版中莉亚在许多地方对美食都表现出热情，所以我为她特别添加了28条收到不同食物时的反馈:D
[u]请多多投喂这位有些窘迫的艺术家！:D[/u]
使用时，请先下载SMAPI和Content Patcher，再下载这个Mod的文件，解压文件后将包含的文件夹放入你的Mods文件夹中。
请注意，婚前对话全年龄适用，但婚后对话包含极微量的、非露骨的成人内容。
希望你喜欢这样的莉亚。后续还会制作属于莉亚的事件拓展，敬请期待。
——————————————————————————————
This is a dialogue expansion mod for Leah, which not only [size=4][b]r[/b][b]ewrites[/b][/size] her daily, post‑marriage, and festival dialogues based on the original ones, but also [b][size=4]adds over 230 new lines of her dialogue[/size][/b]. This makes her a more romantic artist with a finer perception of the world around her.
Additionally, since Leah shows enthusiasm for food in many places in the original game, I have specially added 28 reactions for when she receives different food items as gifts :D 
[u]Please feel free to spoil this somewhat struggling artist with lots of treats!:D[/u]
Please download SMAPI and Content Patcher first, then download the file of this Mod. After unzipping the file, place the included folder into your Mods folder.
This mod maybe rated [size=4][b]PG-13[/b][/size] due to its post-marriage dialogue containing a very small amount of adult content (non-explicit).
I hope you like this Leah. In the future, I will also create an event expansion for Leah, so stay tuned.
